claim_definition: Verifies that the gate records authority revocation in a revocation registry. When revoke_authority is called, the actor is added to the registry and all downstream receipts in the lineage chain are invalidated.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - revocation recording test

input.script:
harmony(1e-12)
bind_authority("officer-42", "compliance_officer", "lending_decisions")
revoke_authority("officer-42", "role_change")
evolve(2)
data(1000)
check_authority("officer-42")
residual()

test_cases.description: The gate must record authority revocation in a revocation registry. The revoked actor must be detectable by check_authority.
